claim.purpose: Prepare and later run the v0.91.7 WP-18 internal milestone review without claiming release readiness

initial.title: [v0.91.7][WP-18][review] Internal review
initial.goal: Run the v0.91.7 WP-18 internal milestone review using the established ADL findings-first review process.
initial.required_outcome: A retained internal review packet and finding register identify missing surfaces, stale claims, overclaims, unowned blockers, validation gaps, lifecycle truth drift, and release-readiness non-claims before external review.
declared_scope: v0.91.7 milestone docs and release-tail planning surfaces
v0.91.7 sprint-review register and retained sprint packets
Open and closed WP issue truth for v0.91.7 WP-01 through WP-23
Lifecycle cards, PR state, validation evidence, and closeout records needed for milestone release-review truth
authority_boundary: docs/reviews/v0.91.7/remaining-sprints-5403/ is retained findings-first sprint review evidence
This issue may find and route blockers but must not silently remediate sibling WP work
initial.task_boundary: Prepare and execute only the WP-18 internal review packet; do not perform WP-19 external review, WP-20 remediation, WP-22 next-milestone review, or WP-23 release ceremony.
deliverables: Retained v0.91.7 internal milestone review packet
Findings register with severity, evidence, disposition, and owner route
Validation adequacy and release-readiness boundary summary
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The review covers WP-01 through WP-23 and named closed sprint packets without silently skipping open or blocked rows
AC-2: Findings are evidence-bound, severity-ranked, and routed to existing or proposed owners
AC-3: The packet distinguishes release-ready, blocked-with-evidence, open, superseded, and not-reviewed surfaces
AC-4: Validation evidence states what was freshly checked, what is retained evidence, and what remains unproven
AC-5: The review does not claim v0.91.7 release readiness or v0.92 activation readiness
dependencies: Open remediation issue state for #5404 through #5413 where applicable
non_goals: Do not execute WP-19 external review
Do not fix findings as part of the review issue unless separately assigned
Do not claim release ceremony readiness
Do not use AWS or remote paid validation lanes for review preparation
Do not rerun broad Rust or runtime suites unless the review execution changes code or tooling
initial.plan_summary: Prepare the typed issue state, bind the review worktree, then run the future milestone review with sprint-review, repo-packet-builder, gap-analysis, specialist review lanes, synthesis, and review-quality evaluation.

steps.action: Prepare typed lifecycle state and bind the WP-18 review worktree
Build a bounded evidence packet for the v0.91.7 milestone review
Run findings-first specialist lanes and synthesize the internal review packet
Validate retained review artifacts and lifecycle truth before publication

invariants: Open issue and PR truth must be verified live during execution
Release and v0.92 readiness claims require integrated proof or explicit blocked/operator-scoped-out evidence
No AWS use for this review preparation
risks: v0.91.7 issue and PR state is moving quickly, so review execution must refresh live truth
Retained sprint packets may be current for their scope but stale after remediation merges
The review can be tempted to absorb remediation work that belongs to WP-20 or child fixes
stop_conditions: Required live issue/PR state cannot be verified
Review scope expands into implementation/remediation without operator assignment
A release-readiness claim depends on unproven or paid remote validation
Root checkout is dirty or tracked issue work would occur on main

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate typed #4645 C-SDLC state and preparation-only review inputs
Validate future review artifacts are whitespace-clean and retained on tracked paths
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Run after the internal review artifacts are written

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on stale issue truth, missing retained evidence, overclaim, or unowned blocker ambiguity.
review_prompts: Does the internal review cover every v0.91.7 WP and retained sprint packet it claims to cover?
Are release-readiness and v0.92 activation claims bounded by integrated proof?
Are findings severity-ranked and routed without absorbing remediation into the review issue?
Does the packet distinguish retained proof, fresh validation, skipped validation, and non-claims?
